findings.evidence: `<meta charset="utf-8">` is the only meta tag present; no `<meta name="viewport">` follows it
findings.fix: Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` to the `<head>`.
findings.violation: There is no viewport meta tag, so this page (clearly meant to represent an app screen) will render at desktop zoom/scale on mobile browsers.

findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 4 projects, synced this morning." followed by a `<ul>` with exactly 3 `<li>` items (Beta Launch Plan, Holiday Campaign Assets, Partner Integration Pilot)
findings.fix: Either change the count to 3, add a 4th list item, or add visible text (e.g. "Recent projects" heading) clarifying the list is a subset of the 4.
findings.violation: The stated project count (4) doesn't match the number of projects actually listed (3), with no label explaining the list is a partial/"recent" subset.

    • ` etc. are plain text, while `Open project settings` is a separate, unparameterized link
findings.fix: Make each `<li>` a link to its own project settings, or rename/explain the standalone link so it's clear which project it opens.
findings.violation: None of the listed projects are clickable, so there is no way to open settings for a specific project; the single "Open project settings" link is disconnected from the list and (per the prefilled form) always opens "Vendor Onboarding," a project that isn't even in the visible list.

findings.fix: Add visible label text or an icon with the `aria-label` reserved for supplementary context, e.g. `<button ...>Duplicate</button>`.
findings.violation: The button has no visible text content or icon - only an `aria-label` - so sighted users have no indication of what the control is or does.

findings.evidence: `<button id="project-settings-duplicate-btn" type="button" aria-label="Duplicate project"></button>` has no `href` and is not wired to any other section
findings.fix: Link or route it to a confirmation/result state (e.g. a new "project duplicated" section), consistent with how Archive and Invite flows work.
findings.violation: Unlike every other action in the mockup, this button leads nowhere - clicking "Duplicate project" has no visible consequence in the prototype.

findings.evidence: `<button id="project-settings-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button>` inside a `<form>` with no `action` attribute and no following confirmation link
findings.fix: Give the form an explicit next state, e.g. link/route Save to a "settings saved" confirmation or back to the overview with a saved indicator.
findings.violation: Saving the project name has no visible outcome - no confirmation state and no navigation - unlike the Invite and Archive flows, which both end in a result page.

findings.fix: Add `required` to the email input (and/or disable the Continue action until a valid email is present).
findings.violation: A user can reach "Invite sent" without entering an email address, yet that page states "An invite was sent to the address entered above," which would be false/blank.

findings.evidence: `` and, separately, `Continue`
findings.fix: Remove the redundant Save button or make "Continue" the form's actual submit action so the invite-sent state is gated on a real submission.
findings.violation: The "Continue" link to the "Invite sent" confirmation is independent of the form's Save/submit action, so a user can reach "Invite sent" without ever saving (or submitting) the invite form.

findings.evidence: `<button id="notification-settings-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button>` inside a form with no `action`; the only other control is `notification-settings-back-link`, an unrelated manual "Back" link
findings.fix: Add a confirmation state or at least auto-navigate back to project settings with a "saved" acknowledgment after Save.
findings.violation: Saving notification settings produces no feedback or confirmation at all, not even the minimal pattern used elsewhere in the document (e.g. invite confirmation).

findings.evidence: `project-archived-exit-link` returns to `#workspace-overview`, whose text still reads "This workspace holds 4 projects, synced this morning."
findings.fix: Update the overview copy (or note that the count is dynamic) so the project count reflects the post-archive state.
findings.violation: After completing the archive flow, the overview screen's project count is not updated to reflect the archived project, leaving stale/contradictory information.
